title: Compose clean native merge with mixed root at raw saving 0.0032868
body:
## Summary

A new composition of Rohan Arun's PR6399 clean native merge with Ali Romman's PR6398 mixed root passes the exact raw saving screen **0.0032868**. Claim type: **scoped accounting proof conditional on the retained native and caller interfaces**, with an exact finite certificate. The predecessor constructions are cited premises, not audit deliverables.

```diff
 complete recursive invoice, eighteen native copies
-18 H1 + 18 H4
+18 H5
 productive histogram unchanged
```

The complete new invoice has 13,652 productive fields and 67,132 paid jobs, preserving rank masses 185,740 and 184,980. Its exact signed gain is `18 (1 + 4^t - 5^t) > 0` for every `0<t<1`. At `t=1-0.0032868`, the combined margin is enclosed in `(0.013061578546729933727885198969, 0.013061578546729933727885198970)`. The original PR6398 invoice has negative margin at this same saving. The extra scratch lifetime and 508 scalar units per native call are charged; the declared local ordinary allowance is 5,512,178, below 10,000,000.

The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Rohan Arun retains the clean-merge construction, Ali Romman the mixed root and original invoice, DreamingOfClouds the shared-carrier lifts, Cinna Davis and Jacob Alan Sussman the caller/productive interfaces, and zxv the interval arithmetic. Exact predecessor proofs, receipts and notices remain unchanged in retained snapshots.

## Evidence and reproduction

On CPython 3.12.15, both warning-strict normal and optimized direct checks pass, taking 0.35 and 0.36 seconds respectively. Both registered commands pass. The verifier constructs every new histogram entry, checks exact interval signs and the ordinary allowance, rejects seven enumerated semantic mutations, and checks 145 exact square-root enclosure controls. RESULT.json is generated and bound to source/verifier hashes.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/clean-native-mixed-root/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/clean-native-mixed-root/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clean-native-mixed-root
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/clean-native-mixed-root --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Use an equivalent Python 3.12 path elsewhere. Committed bytes, modes and declared source history pass for all 14 package/input files. Official export and declared-input coverage pass. Both normal and optimized Git-free replays pass from read-only exported sources with an empty PATH; all 15 exported files, including the export receipt, retain their hashes. Actual source-byte and generated-receipt corruptions reject.

The main-based arithmetic pin is checked through Git history. Six exact external predecessor snapshots are self-contained, SHA256/Git-blob bound and attributed by commit/path/URL; the source-history preflight does not certify their external publication ancestry. No predecessor mathematical replay was used as the deliverable.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is a favorable complete recursive invoice and a declared local ordinary-envelope calculation. It does **not** claim a new whole-algorithm kappa, a combined physical supplier, a selected-frontier update or a complete multiplication theorem. The combined physical/native/caller replay, new completion/compiler parameters, precision/tape validation and outer ledger are unrun. All five inherited framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Bind PR6399's concrete constructor and scratch-zero checker to PR6398's eighteen-call controller, then certify the changed physical contacts, choose strict completion/compiler/outer parameters, and run the combined admission ledger below this raw screen. That is a new composition obligation. It does not require extending this raw threshold first.
